<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

`pij spawn --as role:<id>[/<instance>]` launches a seat with the role's launch settings, assigns it the role and delivers its first turn, in one command, costing a plain spawn plus one writer commit. A spawn with no role still works and warns with the new form. A missing governance seed warns with the command that copies it.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- One step from a role to a briefed seat holding it.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- Changing revive rules (unchanged); pods (PRD 008).

Every refusal here launches nothing and names its step. | [ ] unchecked | — | — | [bp-0001](assets/backpressure.dd.md#rows) | — |
| ac-0003 | After the seat's row is written and before the bind wait, ONE writer commit records the first turn (`community/roles/&lt;id&gt;/first-turns/&lt;seat&gt;.md`) and the holding, then the store row; then the first turn is queued to the seat from its creator, so it is delivered at bind as the seat's first message. The seat receives nothing before that commit. A refused commit rolls the spawn back through the existing failed-row-write path, one code path: the spawn's own pane is removed and its row tombstoned, never by name or pattern; the refusal names the step. <a id="research-context"></a>

## Research Context

spawn_seat and launch_owned in crates/daemon/src/http/mod.rs write the seat's row after tmux's new_window; a failed row write removes the pane. DirectoryService::assign_many commits the holders row; AssignRequest gains the extra file for the first turn.

<a id="execution-guardrails"></a>

## Execution Guardrails

- Cost: the spawn's own launch as today plus one writer commit; no loop, poll or timer.
- No permission rule changes (PRD 003); no daemon enforcement of a type's rules; no existing JSON field removed or renamed.
- Builds nice-19 through `just shared-build`, one at a time.
